name: The Ritz-Carlton, Shenzhen
positioning: Minimalist, nature-inspired luxury hotel in Shenzhen's Futian District business center, with Chinese and Italian restaurants and a spa
best_for: Business and convention travelers who want a base in Futian District
Travelers who want a spa and several dining options in one hotel

facts.text: Set in the Futian District, moments from the Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center.
The hotel is set in Shenzhen's center of commerce.
The hotel's design mixes natural elements with minimalist décor.
Rooms and suites all have floor-to-ceiling windows and stand-alone soaking tubs.
Paletto Italian Restaurant serves contemporary and traditional Italian food and has a dining suite for intimate gatherings and celebrations.
Onyx Lobby Lounge serves afternoon tea, snacks and light lunch or dinner daily, with live music.
Curv Cigar Bar offers drinks, light snacks and live jazz.
Flavorz All-Day Dining Restaurant offers a variety of dishes and seasonal specialties.
The Signature Elements massage combines aromatherapy, Bamboo Oriental, Oriental Thai and Lava Hot Stone massages around a philosophy of wood, water, fire and earth.
The fitness center has exercise equipment and a yoga studio.
The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool.
Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards 2026.

highlights.text: The Club Lounge offers city-center views and a light show on Friday and Saturday.
Xingli Chinese Restaurant serves Chiu Chow, Cantonese and Szechuan cuisines and has 23 individual private rooms.
The Ritz Kids Night Safari lets children set up a camping tent inside the suite.
The concierge arranges a tea and Shenzhen culture day-trip.
The Ritz-Carlton Spa partners with Swiss skincare brand Valmont and Spanish skincare brand Natura Bissé for massage, facial and body treatments.

considerations.text: The minimum age for the spa and fitness center is above 16.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: The Ritz-Carlton, Shenzhen
